tools.name: check_picks
tools.description: Call this first, and it is free. Give the picks document of a pump.fun trading bot, and it says whether the replay would take it, with a sentence that names what to change if not, and whether its first pick fits the free sample. It does not look at the chain.

tools.name: replay_first_pick
tools.description: Replays the first pick of a picks document against the trades that really happened on the chain and returns what it would have brought: the price after the bot's own delay, the effect of its own order, every fee, the result in SOL beside the simplest paper trade, or the reason the order would have f

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Returns a picks document made from three real buys of a real bot on pump.fun, together with the full answer the replay gives for it, so the format of both can be copied.

tools.name: how_to_buy_a_full_run
tools.description: Says how to replay a whole document of up to 50 picks, which costs 1 USDC and is paid by the bot's own wallet over x402 on Solana with a plain HTTP request, when a run is charged and when it is not, and how a buyer fetches a paid answer again.
